All design and marketing assets should adhere to these guidelines to ensure a consistent brand experience. --- ## Logo - Always use the approved logo files — do not recreate or alter the logo - Minimum size: 24px height for digital use - Maintain clear space equal to the height of the logo mark on all sides ## Color Palette
**Color** **Hex** **Usage**
Primary Blue #2D6CDF CTAs, links, key UI elements
Off White #F9F9F7 Page backgrounds
Charcoal #1A1A1A Body text
Warm Gray #6B6B6B Secondary text, captions
## Typography - **Headings:** Inter, Bold (700) — sizes H1: 48px, H2: 32px, H3: 24px - **Body:** Inter, Regular (400) — 16px, 1.6 line height - **Captions / Labels:** Inter, Medium (500) — 12px, uppercase, 0.08em letter spacing ## Imagery - Use high-contrast, human-centered photography - Avoid stock photos that feel generic or staged - Product screenshots should use the latest UI — no outdated screens - All images must be optimized for web (WebP preferred, max 200kb) ## Do's and Don'ts - ✅ Use approved color palette and typography only - ✅ Maintain generous white space - ✅ Keep the logo on solid or approved background colors - ❌ Do not stretch, recolor, or add effects to the logo - ❌ Do not use off-brand fonts or colors - ❌ Do not use low-resolution images
